[[File:Menagerie_Dragons.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Menagerie dragons on Skarpos.]]
'''Menagerie dragons''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of winged reptilian [[dragon]]s employed by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Malakite]], ruler of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] princedom known as [[the Menagerie]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. They were used as airborne combat platforms and were ridden by [[Mutate]] riders. Since Malakite eschewed technology, he preferred to use bio-engineered [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] to overwhelm smaller numbers of technologically-superior foes. <ref name="Escape">[[Knight Errant: Escape 4|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 4]]</ref>

During the [[Massacre on Skarpos|Second Battle of Skarpos]], two Mutates and their dragon steeds stumbled upon Sith Lord [[Odion]], ruler of the rival Sith state known as the [[Odionate]], at the top of the [[Morbollon Mesa]]. However, Odion used the [[Helm of Ieldis]] to eliminate this threat by driving the dragons and their riders into a homicidal frenzy which ended in their deaths.<ref name="Escape" />
